description: This file contains unit tests for the IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer, which checks for improper use of serialization attributes on Orleans grain classes. It verifies that attributes like [Alias] and [GenerateSerializer] are not applied to grain classes, which should not be serialized, but allows them on non-grain classes. The tests cover various scenarios including inheriting from Grain or Grain<T>, with and without attributes, and use Xunit for testing.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer, ensuring it correctly identifies improper use of serialization attributes on Orleans grain classes.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic

methods.description: Asserts that the provided code snippet does not trigger any diagnostics from the analyzer.
